title: Weighted Quadrature on Unstructured Splines
summary: This work presents a weighted quadrature (WQ) method to fast assemble Galerkin matrices based on unstructured spline surfaces. The method is developed upon a particular variant of unstructured splines, namely the bicubic analysis-suitable unstructured T-splines (ASUTS).
